incident.software_contribution: Unqualified full sleep remains refused; radio clocks block C3; recurring userspace and navigation timers remain. A runtime PCM slot initialization defect is separately established and reproduced as a charging-protection failure association.

charging.pc_observed: Charging 450000 configured ceiling; no fault in current boot.
charging.wall_observed: 650000 configured ceiling; C3-enabled test protection fault0x80; C3-gated five-minute test positive voltage slope/no fault.
